Outcome.DescriptionText: Outside the temple your troops meet a scavenger named Yuriy who speaks in a strange dialect. He found an old relic in the temple and will sell it for 550 credits.
Your troops hear sounds in the temple. A nest of burrowing predators lives there. The troops place charges around the main supports and the temple comes down on them.
The temple walls are covered with primitive carvings worshipping a god that came from the sky. As your team examines the roof, they notice a sentinel ship in orbit that has been watching them.
A hidden chamber holds a data core of schematics for an unknown technology. When it is removed, the whole structure begins to tremble.
Outcome.ConfirmText: Armour that ages like fine wine

Outcome.DescriptionText: From outside, the huge pyramid looks like a temple, but inside it is a large housing complex.
An energy source deep in the temple leads your team to a faint sound of two beings arguing. It is an old computer core, and it appears to want a word.
Outcome.ConfirmText: We are all equal, more or less

Outcome.DescriptionText: A group of scavengers opens fire. They are dealt with, but they belonged to a larger Orion band and the rest of it is on its way.
The temple looks like a vault. At the centre is a sealed room with two huge doors that won't open. Your team forces them. Inside is a world seed, and a patrol of automated craft arrives.
Barricades are broken and the remains of the temple's former occupants lie in the corridors. In a laboratory is a manual that describes an experiment on the dead. The experiment is still running.
The temple walls are covered with primitive carvings and mosaics that worship a god in the sky. In the largest chamber your team finds schematics for a troop design.
